newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt lower.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,100 slaughter steers and 500 heifers; 26,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 17,400 formulated and 400 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 65.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 950-1050 lbs 65.00, pen North Plains 66.00.
Wk to Date - 26,700 Week ago - 85,500 Year ago - 31,700
